funds.name: Town general fund
funds.what: What the schools bring in that the Town books as its own general fund receipt: preschool tuition, student parking fees and a school medical reimbursement. None of it is booked to a school fund.

text.history_note: Each bar is what the Town received; a tick is what it estimated, where a record prints it. A blank year is one no record we hold prints.
text.not_school: These are Town receipts: no account in the school journal, in any fund, is named for any of them.
